items.title: Ann Rabson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 21, 2007
items.q: I heard Big Bill Broonzy playing live on the radio. And I was just blown away. I mean I’d heard lots of music in my home, but it was like this was my music.

ctx.x: I was four years old and I heard live on the radio, a college radio, Purdue’s radio station, I heard Big Bill Broonzy playing live on the radio. And I was just blown away. I mean I’d heard lots of music in my home, but it was like this was my music. It was like, and he was singing, you know looking back I know, one of the songs he sang was “I’m Going to Move Way Out on the Outskirts of Town.” And I know that as a kid you can’t really understanding the sort of sexual innuendo and all that. But what came through to…
